title: Store Login
intro: Pick a store and log in using a browser inside this add-on. You then get a refresh token for the Store Receipts integration.
hint: Tap a field to type straight into it: the keyboard opens by itself. Tap the captcha to click it. Drag over the screen to scroll.
result_html: Success! Copy this refresh token. Go to Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Store Receipts, choose and paste it into “Refresh token”. Use the token only once.
timeout: Time is up, please start again.
http_block: The store answered with HTTP {status} (possibly bot protection)
load_failed: Could not load the store list.
